title: Free exercise machines now open to the public at Salinas Community Center
excerpt: Webb County is offering free use of exercise machines at the Fernando A. Salinas Community Center, 520 Reynolds St. in Laredo, Monday through Friday starting at 8:15 a.m. — no membership, no fees.
content:
Webb County is offering free use of exercise machines to the public at the Fernando A. Salinas Community Center, the county announced Monday.

The machines are available Monday through Friday starting at 8:15 a.m. at the center, 520 Reynolds St. in Laredo. There is no membership and no fee — anyone in the community can walk in and use them, and they are open to all ages and fitness levels.

The county says regular exercise improves heart health, builds strength, boosts energy, helps manage weight and improves mood. Residents can call the center at 956-523-4770 for more information.

Sources: Webb County, Texas, Nov. 10, 2026; webbcountytx.gov.
